data.title: Polish Website Interactions
data.outcome: Use consistent, restrained state feedback to make interactions feel trustworthy instead of piling on decorative animation.

stages.title: Show basic feedback for hover, focus, and press
stages.action: Add all three basic states to primary controls.
stages.evidence: Mouse and keyboard users can both tell which control they are interacting with.

lessons.title: Hover
lessons.tagline: Respond when a pointer rests over an interactive element

lessons.title: Focus
lessons.tagline: Show which element will receive keyboard input

lessons.title: Active
lessons.tagline: Show that a control is being pressed right now

stages.title: Clearly explain when an action is unavailable
stages.action: Explain why a control is disabled and what must happen before it is available.
stages.evidence: Users do not keep clicking a disabled control with no explanation.

lessons.title: Disabled
lessons.tagline: Show that a control is currently unavailable

lessons.title: Tooltip
lessons.tagline: Explain a compact control with a short text label

stages.title: Choose the right feedback for each wait
stages.action: Choose a loading treatment based on the scope and progress of the wait.
stages.evidence: Users know the system is still working and whether they can continue.

lessons.title: Spinner
lessons.tagline: A rotating indicator that shows a short, indeterminate wait

lessons.title: Skeleton
lessons.tagline: Reserve the layout while content is loading

lessons.title: Progress
lessons.tagline: Show how much of a task has been completed

stages.title: Animate only meaningful changes
stages.action: Use consistent duration and easing for expanding, switching, and moving.
stages.evidence: Motion clarifies the before-and-after relationship and respects reduced-motion preferences.

lessons.title: Transition
lessons.tagline: Smooth the change between two visual states

lessons.title: Easing
lessons.tagline: Control how motion speeds up and slows down

lessons.title: Animation
lessons.tagline: Run a planned sequence of visual changes
